properties.name: xxl.register.admin-api-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum attempts for each XXL-JOB admin API call. Values greater than 1 enable retry with linear backoff.

properties.name: xxl.register.admin-api-backoff-millis
properties.description: Base retry backoff in milliseconds for XXL-JOB admin API calls. The effective wait is base backoff multiplied by the attempt number.

properties.name: xxl.register.admin-api-circuit-failure-threshold
properties.description: Number of failed XXL-JOB admin API operations that opens the circuit breaker.

properties.name: xxl.register.admin-api-circuit-open-duration-millis
properties.description: How long the XXL-JOB admin API circuit breaker stays open before allowing a half-open probe.
